chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Yūnus, from Ibn Miskān, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
If a man kills two men, or more than that, he is killed for them.

key_terms.الرَّجُلُ: the man; the male offender mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.رَجُلَيْنِ: two men; two victims of killing
key_terms.قُتِلَ: he is killed; the prescribed retaliatory punishment is carried out on him

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if one man kills two or more people in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning intentional killing when one person has killed two or more people. It establishes that such a killer is subject to qisas, expressing the seriousness of unlawful killing within Islamic jurisprudence.
